cs.criterion: ANO, pokud Rada EU (tisková zpráva, stránka zasedání nebo předsednictví) uvede, že ministři dosáhli politické dohody o nařízení Rady o rybolovných možnostech v Baltském moři na rok 2027 a dohoda padla nejpozději ve 23:59 SEČ 26. října 2026 – doloženo tiskovou zprávou Rady s datem 26. října 2026, nebo prohlášením předsednictví či ministra nebo zprávou agentury s časem zveřejnění nejpozději 23:59 SEČ 26. října, že dohoda je uzavřena. Dohoda po půlnoci (tisková zpráva z 27. října se slovem „dnes“), odklad nebo žádná dohoda na tomto zasedání = NE.

agents.reason: Unchanged. The signals contain nothing. Base class is a day-1 agreement in 0/3 years (Laplace ~0.2), against an unknown day split and an overnight-negotiation norm. p_held means agreement at this Council at all; p_if_held means before Monday midnight.

0/3 for 2023-25: the item was opened on day 1 (in 2025 too) but agreed overnight, with press releases at 10:15-11:15 on day 2. The day split for 26-27 Oct is unknown; large herring and sprat increases may reduce friction, but cod by-catch cuts and the removal of the coastal exemption are contentious. No market. A deal before midnight on day 1 is unlikely.

No market or model found; unchanged. Base rate 0/3 for a day-1 announcement (overnight negotiation, press release 10:15–11:15 on day 2 in 2023–2025); Baltic item is no. 5 behind the CAP partial general approach with the day split unconfirmed, so p_held (item opened Monday) ~0.80 and p_if_held (deal sealed and time-stamped before midnight) ~0.13. The adversarial case for YES — large herring/sprat increases, a non-Baltic Irish presidency, early minister posts — is not enough to beat the ritual of the all-nighter.
agents.note: While reading edition No. 4 for background during the blind step it saw stale market lines on other questions (Brazil winner, Bulgaria margins); none on these five claims; recorded by the agent.

agents.reason: Laplace-smoothed 0/3 gives 0.20; day split unknown and the item might sit on Tuesday (NO by construction), and talks usually run overnight. Slight upward consideration for a less contested proposal (large herring/sprat increases) does not offset; p_held = agreement at this Council (1 − 0.15 eu-council-adoption slip), p_if_held = done before midnight on day 1.

anchor.source: Base rate: October AGRIFISH Baltic agreement reached on day 1, Council press releases 2023–2025 (0/3), Laplace (0+1)/(3+2)=0.20

agents.reason: No markets or models. The 0/3 day-1 base rate and the overnight pattern stand.
